entities.summary: Elfodd, Elvodug or Elfoddw was a Welsh bishop. He is credited with inducing the Welsh church to accept the Roman computus for determining the date of Easter endorsed elsewhere in Britain at the Synod of Whitby in 664. This was after centuries of continuing the practice.
